sameturn.label: A multiplier was killed this very game turn
sameturn.explanation: A level-12 Warrior with full food, light and hit points checks whether it may rest on the game turn it killed a multiplying monster, then again one game turn later. Original: the first check passes the 'recent multiplier kill' test (the timer is exactly 0) and clears the timer, so the second check, one turn after the kill, finds no recent kill and allows resting. Corrected: the timer is kept and the second check refuses.
